description: deleteSshKey: Stage removal of an SSH key from your account. This does not affect servers already built with it, and the key can simply be added again. Requires authentication. Returns an actionId; present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: deleteSshKey
